reviews.text: I have been coming to Fairbanks animal clinic for my pets for a long time. Great veterinarians and friendly and professional staff.

Ive been coming here for over 20 years.  I drive from Katy to see them.  They have helped me through 3 dogs that have gone to the bridge.  I have chosen them again with my new baby.  Very compassionate,  thorough, and kind.  Every employee treats you like family.  Would highly recommend anyone to this practice.

I brought in my 14 yr old cat for an arthritis pain shot.  They took him away into the back to do the exam, which should be what the exam room is for.  2 days later he  came down with a upper respiratory infection.  When I called to let them know they need to disinfect, the receptionist did not give a shit.  I will never go back.
Dr Sabo is excellent and very personable. Staff are wonderful. Didn't have to wait and appointment was on time. Still wonderful years later.
very attentive, informative, caring, and affordable vet.  Professional an passionate for Animal's the way it should be when you come to a veterinaryclini clinic.
Everyone here is always friendly and genuinely care for your animals.
They are really helpful and kind.

I used to love this vet office. Before the change of ownership Fairbanks was a clinic that I absolutely trusted. I live in the heights and drive an hour round trip just to go to Fairbanks. Now, the clinic is dirty, front desk staff seem unknowledgeable, and the veterinary care has plummeted. I’ve been taking my cat for heart failure and when his blood work was taken, it had not been placed in the refrigerator for over 8 hours, compromising his results. I’ve seen german cockroaches all over the floor of the lobby and the rooms. Such a shame that a clinic I trusted with my whole heart has gone downhill.
Pleasant experience. Easy to get prescribed medicine. No pressure to spend unnecessary money
I've been using Fairbanks for over 20 years. A small remote vet with reasonable prices. Won't invent problems to pad the bill. They fill prescriptions too.

Only place I would trust taking my pet. The crew has been there for many years and they seem to know all the pet names as soon as they walk in the door.
The entire staff treat your pets like royalty. They Talk to them like little people.  I love  it. Thank you Doctor K for taking  care of my little Jojo ❤️

Ever since the original doctors left it hasn’t been the same. I’ve been taking my kitties to this place for more than 12 years. The new set of doctors are ehhh but I highly recommend Dr. Alla Kiienko, she knows her academics and I fully trust her with my baby she’s very compassionate and I hope she stays at this clinic. I do not trust anyone else with my cat but her. They did change their hours of operation. They used to be open on Sundays but not anymore.

They are no longer the trusted clinic I got used to many years ago. I take my dog in for a monthly shot for her allergies and this time they decided to hold her hostage to charge me all kind of extras that I didn't need.
Furthermore, I don't believe they even gave her the shot this time, as they took her in the back instead of giving it to her in my presence. Usually she is much calmer after the shot but now it doesn't seem to be working? Huh.
Do not trust these people anymore. It's a shame too because they used to be one of the better clinics in the area.

We brought our beloved Harrison in for end-of-life support. He was 15 years old. Although we were new patients to this clinic, we were treated with so much respect and compassion that it felt like we had been longtime clients.

From Mary, the receptionist who answered the phone and scheduled our appointment, to the other receptionist whose name I unfortunately didn’t get, everyone was incredibly kind and caring. She showed us to the exam room and explained the process with compassion and patience.

We had to make the difficult decision to proceed with euthanasia that day, and the staff showed tremendous sensitivity by allowing us to pay for services in the room so we wouldn’t have to stop at the front desk on our way out.

The veterinarian, vet techs, and reception staff all reassured us that we could take as much time as we needed, and we never once felt rushed. The veterinarian carefully explained all the details and options, provided professional recommendations, and never made us feel pressured or overwhelmed.

Thank you to the entire staff for making such a heartbreaking day a little easier to get through.
